scope: standard-library exact replay of the p=53 endpoint-spectrum Farkas certificate
conclusion: The explicit A_m/B_m/C_m endpoint spectrum at m=4 has no hive and therefore cannot be an LR-feasible spectrum.
limitation: The certificate does not disprove the existence of a different p=53 optimum with cost 8843 or rank 115, nor any weaker cost/rank recurrence.
